phrases.note: Clarify: nói lại đề trước khi gõ. Không nhảy vào code.

example.en: Let me restate the problem in my own words.
example.vi: Mình restated đề bằng lời mình.

example.en: What are the constraints on n?
example.vi: n tối đa bao nhiêu ạ?

phrases.note: Xin giả định. Tốt hơn im rồi sai.

example.vi: Mình giả định mảng chưa sort được không?

example.en: So the input is an array of ints, output is the index.
example.vi: Input là mảng int, output là index.

pattern.title: Restate then constraints
pattern.pattern: Let me restate the problem → What are the constraints? / Can I assume…? → So the input is…
pattern.explainVi: Trước khi gõ: restated đề, hỏi constraint, xin giả định, chốt input/output. Không nhảy vào code.

aiPrompt.scenario: Coding interview opening. Push the learner to restate a REAL problem they know, then ask constraints.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Let me restate the problem; What are the constraints?; Can I assume…?; Can I use an example?; So the input is…. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Coding interview opening. Push the learner to restate a REAL problem they know, then ask constraints.
